description: Implementation of the GLHelper class for managing OpenGL ES 2.0 rendering, including shader setup, surface creation, and EGL context management within Android.

classes.name: GLHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing OpenGL ES rendering, shader compilation, surface creation, and EGL context handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes EGL display, context, surface, and sets up shaders.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up EGL resources and shader programs.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes a given EGLSurface current for rendering.

methods.name: createSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Creates a surface texture and associated EGL surface.

methods.name: swapBuffers
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers of an EGL surface.

methods.name: getShaderProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a shader program by name.

methods.name: createNamedSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Creates a named surface texture with associated EGL surface.

methods.name: computeWindowScale
methods.description: Calculates scale factor based on display mode and window size.

methods.name: createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface with specified dimensions.

methods.name: setUpShaders
methods.description: Compiles and links shader programs from shader descriptions.

methods.name: getDitherTexture
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a dithering texture.
